{"task": {"id": "I_kwDOUjYZpM8AAAABUhfaFg", "item_id": "PVTI_lAHOAHSLSM4BlRsezg-Cubs", "project_id": "PVT_kwHOAHSLSM4BlRse", "number": 85, "title": "Align Issue acceptance guidance with GitWeave’s agent-verifiable criteria", "body": "## Problem

GitWeave has completed [Issue #110](https://github.com/takahirox/gitweave/issues/110) in [PR #111](https://github.com/takahirox/gitweave/pull/111), adding guidance for choosing completion criteria suitable for AI-assisted work. projectweave has its own copies of the Issue template and development guidance, so that change does not propagate automatically.

The current `.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/issue.md` and `docs/development-flow.md` do not include this guidance. Without it, an Issue can make an unnecessary physical-device check, subjective evaluation, or external approval mandatory and block otherwise autonomous work.

## Expected outcome

Apply the same policy in the existing two files, preserving projectweave's document structure and repository-specific rules:

- Add the policy to the Issue-authoring section of `docs/development-flow.md`.
- Add a concise reminder under “Expected outcome” in `.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/issue.md`, with a working link to the local development guidance. The current section link is https://github.com/takahirox/projectweave/blob/main/docs/development-flow.md#1-start-with-an-issue . Keep the template small rather than adding a checklist.

Use the agreed policy from GitWeave:

> By default, completion criteria should be executable and verifiable by an AI agent. Require human checks, such as physical-device testing, subjective evaluation, or external approval, only when there is a necessary reason to do so.
>
> When human work is required, state why it is necessary and what result is expected. Distinguish optional additional validation from mandatory completion criteria.

A corresponding short template reminder can follow GitWeave's wording:

> Default to completion criteria an AI agent can execute and verify. Require human checks only when necessary; explain why and the expected result, and distinguish optional validation from mandatory criteria.

Keep repository artifacts in English. Human validation remains allowed when necessary; do not remove genuinely required checks or present unperformed checks as passing. Do not introduce a requirement to name a human tester, or a new policy about Issue splitting/updates. Do not change existing product-specific acceptance requirements, runtime behavior, review/merge rules, or unrelated documents. No new CI, bots, workflow fields, or document framework is needed.

Completion means both existing files contain the policy/reminder, the template link reaches the correct local section, and the diff is limited to this wording change. Verify wording, document navigation, and whitespace; do not require manual/physical-device acceptance for this documentation change.

## Context

- Completed reference: https://github.com/takahirox/gitweave/issues/110
- Reference implementation: https://github.com/takahirox/gitweave/pull/111
- Canonical development guidance: https://github.com/takahirox/gitweave/blob/main/docs/development-flow.md#1-start-with-an-issue
- Canonical Issue template: https://github.com/takahirox/gitweave/blob/main/.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/issue.md

This Issue propagates the same agreed wording to projectweave's existing template and guidance. Review-stage waiting for necessary human input is separate work tracked in https://github.com/takahirox/projectweave/issues/84 .
